ki.$description: More contrast (spec 043): neutral text at 7:1 or more, neutral control boundaries at 4.5:1, separators and container edges at 3:1, a 3px focus ring. References only, so one file serves every theme and scheme; it always applies over reduced transparency, which more contrast implies. Text on brand and tone fills, brand and tone boundaries and disabled controls are unchanged (spec 043 D1, D2): the outline emphasis ramp itself is left alone because disabled borders draw from it.

supporting.$description: Enabled supporting text — labels, placeholders, secondary lines — on the scheme-aware 72% neutral ink. The med-em step itself is left alone: disabled ink draws from it.

control.$description: Control boundaries at 4.5:1 or more against s0-s2.

control-hover.$description: Hovered control boundary, a step beyond the rest boundary.

border-color.$description: The card edge at 3:1 or more against the page, in every theme.

color.$description: Resting pager dots on the strong outline: 3:1 against the page and, where colour alone marks the current dot (material3), 3:1 from it — the strengthened control boundary would have closed that gap.
The divider rule at 3:1 or more against the page.

divider-color.$description: Row dividers, where a theme draws them, at 3:1 or more.

border-width.$description: Alerts draw a 2px edge in every theme.
